General Remarks.

The land sold during the nine months amounted to 80,358.01 acres, which realized $422,086.13. The quantity of
surrendered land in the hands of the department was, approximately, 229,923.65 acres. The principal outstanding, on
account of Indian lands sold, amounted to $631,177.58, a considerable portion of which has not yet become due.
